description: One skill per backend domain / frontend area. Read a skill's README.md before the rest of the codebase when working on that module — it's the fast path and avoids re-deriving what's already documented there.

skills.name: backend-auth
skills.description: Signup, login, Google OAuth, token refresh/logout, password reset, and the JWT/RBAC primitives (get_current_user, require_roles) every other domain depends on.

skills.name: backend-users
skills.description: Managing an organization's user roster: list, invite, fetch, update role/name/active status, and delete users.

skills.name: backend-organizations
skills.description: Reading and updating the current user's own organization record (the tenant boundary itself, not a tenant-scoped resource).

skills.name: backend-core
skills.description: Cross-cutting infrastructure: environment config, the AppError/exception-handler contract, logging setup, the trial/subscription gate, and request middleware (rate limiting, request-id/IP capture).

skills.name: backend-patients
skills.description: CRUD for the patients entity (list/create/get/update/delete) plus a nested endpoint listing a patient's studies.

skills.name: backend-studies
skills.description: CRUD for the studies entity (imaging studies belonging to a patient), plus the combined patient+study+upload+analysis intake flow.

skills.name: backend-uploads
skills.description: Validates and stores a file attached to a study, and serves uploaded files back out through a signed, time-limited URL.

skills.name: backend-intake
skills.description: Stateless chat-style intake parsing: turns a free-text physician message into structured patient/study fields and reports what's still missing.

skills.name: backend-analysis
skills.description: Triggers and tracks the synchronous, in-request AI-analysis pipeline for a study (imaging interpretation, report drafting, analysis-job status polling).

skills.name: backend-reports
skills.description: Owns report read/list, manual edits, AI change-requests, regeneration, finalization, and PDF rendering/download, always appending immutable versions rather than mutating in place.

skills.name: backend-templates
skills.description: Owns organization report-template branding and section layout: CRUD, logo upload, and live (unsaved-draft) PDF preview.

skills.name: backend-ai
skills.description: Pluggable AI provider abstraction (imaging interpretation + report generation interfaces) with Anthropic, Gemini, and mock implementations selected via AI_PROVIDER.

skills.name: backend-database
skills.description: SQLAlchemy async engine/session lifecycle and the SQLAlchemy table models every repository maps to, plus the camelCase<->snake_case casing conversion layer.

skills.name: backend-repositories
skills.description: The persistence layer between services and the database: BaseRepository's shared CRUD/dict-shape/org-scoping convention plus one repository subclass per table.

skills.name: backend-storage
skills.description: Pluggable signed-URL file storage abstraction (local disk, S3/S3-compatible, Firebase) selected at runtime via STORAGE_PROVIDER.

skills.name: backend-platform
skills.description: The system_admin role and cross-organization platform operations: bootstrapping the first system_admin, inviting more, and onboarding new organizations.

skills.name: backend-billing
skills.description: Trial/subscription gating for AI report generation and the Stripe checkout + webhook flow that activates or expires an organization's paid subscription.

skills.name: backend-dashboard
skills.description: Read-only, org-scoped dashboard rollups: headline stats and a recent-activity feed over studies, reports, analysis jobs, and audit logs.

skills.name: backend-audit-logs
skills.description: The audit trail every mutating service call writes to, plus the org_admin-only filtered/paginated listing route.

skills.name: backend-notifications
skills.description: In-app, user-scoped notifications: create (in-app only, no email/SMS yet), list, mark-read, and mark-all-read.

skills.name: frontend-pages
skills.description: The top-level route screens (one folder per route) that fetch data via the api modules and render the shared loading/error/empty/content pattern.

skills.name: frontend-routes
skills.description: The client-side route table and the auth/role guard components (ProtectedRoute, RoleRoute) every protected route is wrapped in.

skills.name: frontend-api
skills.description: The axios-based HTTP layer (one *.api.ts module per backend domain, shared axiosInstance with token-refresh) and the wire type definitions in types/index.ts.

skills.name: frontend-context
skills.description: React context providers for auth/session and light-dark theme, plus the app's shared standalone hooks (click-outside, job polling, debounced PDF preview, scroll reveal).

skills.name: frontend-ui-components
skills.description: Generic, domain-agnostic UI primitives (Table, Pagination, Select, Tabs, Toast) shared across every feature area.

skills.name: frontend-components
skills.description: Pre-existing generic building blocks (components/common) plus every feature-specific component folder (layout, patients, studies, reports, templates, upload) that compose them into product UI.

skills.name: frontend-styles
skills.description: The global design-token system (colors, spacing, radii, light/dark theme) and base element reset that every component CSS file draws from.
